project_description: Complete the versioned-runtime migration by converging the standard distribution on one process runtime, one canonical generation runtime, one host, one reload contract, and one generation-resource lifecycle owner; delete the legacy Built/RunWithRuntime/bootstrap compatibility graph, decompose reload coordination by ownership, eliminate duplicate config reads and fake check-config publication, remove deprecated public option shapes under the alpha-stage compatibility decision, and ratchet architecture budgets downward while preserving all existing protocol, reload, security, streaming, no-drop, lifecycle, and public-facade behavior.
